findings.finding: RUN_MATRIX still referenced 40 fixtures and 88 outputs after the governance extension.
findings.resolution: Aligned both primary arms to all 52 fixtures and set minimum outputs to 112.

findings.finding: SCORING_AND_GATES did not yet include activation recall, false negatives, negative transfer, documentation overhead, proportionality, reversibility, token cost, latency cost or net decision value.
findings.resolution: Added metrics, rubric dimensions, aggregation rules and dedicated gates.

findings.finding: Scorer calibration and disagreement logging were defined in the extension but not enforced by the primary scoring contract.
findings.resolution: Made calibration a precondition and required frozen rationales before unblinding.

findings.finding: The execution contract did not explicitly freeze model, reasoning, tool, retry, timeout and prompt configuration as one reproducibility package.
findings.resolution: Added a mandatory configuration freeze and hash mismatch stop condition.

claim_boundaries: The review validates design consistency, not Product Leadership value.
No corpus or model output was generated.
No scoring or external audit was executed.
Product Leadership remains inactive and not integrated.
Product Leadership has no governance authority.
Test execution requires a separate explicit authorization.
